item.text: I hit a shell-policy restriction on the comparison harness. I’m rerunning the parity check without the cleanup step so I can still get a direct diff across several representative cases.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "cat <<'EOF' >/tmp/test12_compare.sh
set -e
run_case() {
  args=\""'$1"
  py_out=$(mktemp)
  js_out=$(mktemp)
  py_code=0
  js_code=0
  /workspace/dataset/test12_executable $args >"$py_out" 2>&1 || py_code=$?
  node /output/test12.mjs $args >"$js_out" 2>&1 || js_code=$?
  sed -i '"'s/test12_executable/test12.mjs/g' \""'$py_out"
  if [ "$py_code" -ne "$js_code" ]; then
    echo "EXIT_MISMATCH [$args] py=$py_code js=$js_code"
    echo PY
    cat "$py_out"
    echo JS
    cat "$js_out"
    exit 1
  fi
  if ! diff -u "$py_out" "$js_out"; then
    echo "DIFF_FAILED [$args]"
    exit 1
  fi
}
run_case '"'--a 1 --b 2 --c 3'
run_case ''
run_case '--help'
run_case '--a foo --b 2 --c 3'
run_case '--a 1 --a 2 --b 3 --c 4'
run_case '--a --b 2 --c 3'
run_case '--help=1'
run_case 'extra --a 1'
run_case '--x 1 --a 2 --b 3 --c 4'
echo OK
EOF
bash /tmp/test12_compare.sh"
